**Short answer:** The core `Concept` type is `packages/framework/esm-api/src/types/concept-resource.ts`, re-exported through `@openmrs/esm-framework`. Only two patient-chart files import that type from the framework. Other chart code is affected indirectly through `NumericObservation`, which takes a concept UUID. Most other `Concept` declarations in the chart are local interfaces and would not change with core.

**Direct consumers of the framework `Concept` type (strongest):**
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-common-lib/src/orders/postOrders.ts` imports `Concept` from `@openmrs/esm-framework` (lines 1-10). It uses it in the `ObsPayload` shape that gets posted to the encounter endpoint (lines 131-135).
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-generic-patient-widgets-app/src/obs-table-horizontal/obs-table-horizontal.component.tsx` imports `Concept` from `@openmrs/esm-framework` (lines 2-17). It is used in the `HorizontalTable` props as `concepts: Array<Concept>` (lines 269-278).

**Indirect consumers via `NumericObservation` (concept-UUID-driven reference ranges in core):**
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-chart-app/src/clinical-views/encounter-list/encounter-list.component.tsx` passes `conceptUuid={column.concept}` (line 182).
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-chart-app/src/clinical-views/encounter-tile/encounter-tile.component.tsx` renders `NumericObservation` (line 74).
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-vitals-app/src/vitals-and-biometrics-header/vitals-header-item.component.tsx` renders `NumericObservation` (line 23).
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-vitals-app/src/vitals/paginated-vitals.component.tsx` renders `NumericObservation` (lines 99 and 130).
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-vitals-app/src/biometrics/paginated-biometrics.component.tsx` renders `NumericObservation` (line 94).
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-chart-app/src/clinical-views/encounter-list/table.component.tsx` checks `cellContent.type === NumericObservation` (line 48).

**Not affected by a core change:** these chart files declare their own `Concept` types and do not import the framework one: `esm-patient-tests-app/src/types.ts`, `esm-patient-notes-app/src/types/index.ts`, `esm-form-entry-app/src/app/types/index.ts`, `esm-patient-common-lib/src/orders/types/order.ts`, and `esm-patient-chart-app/src/visit/hooks/useVisitAttributeType.tsx`. The chart files that use those local types are not listed above. The framework's `Obs`, `Order`, `Drug`, `Diagnosis` and `Person` types also reference `Concept`, so chart code that reads those fields is also exposed, but I did not enumerate every such access.

**Limits:** Falkon returned 138 references for `Concept` in the chart, and I only checked the import sources of the files that matched the framework import. The indirect `NumericObservation` list comes from a regex search, not an exhaustive trace.
